yaml.title: Consulting
yaml.description: Bioinformatics pipelines, cloud data platforms, and scientific AI for life sciences.

markdown.markdown:
I help biotech and research teams turn sequencing and scientific data into **reproducible pipelines, dependable cloud workflows, and usable data products**. 10+ years across biotech, consulting, NIH, and FDA.
Four focused offerings
::: {.consulting-grid} ::: {.consulting-card}
01 / WORKFLOWS
From a folder of scripts to a workflow your team can rerun, inspect, and hand over. - **Bulk and single-cell RNA-seq** processing and analysis - **Antibody repertoire NGS**, including customized nf-core/airrflow - **Nextflow** with containers and Python/R notebooks **Deliverable:** a documented, runnable pipeline with handover.
Background: bulk and single-cell RNA-seq pipelines at FDA; an antibody pipeline for 2B+ sequences.
Nextflow · Snakemake · Python · R · Containers
::: ::: {.consulting-card}
02 / CLOUD COMPUTE
### Cloud foundations for scientific workloads Storage and compute sized to your data and budget, on AWS or Azure in your own account. - **Raw, processed, and results** data organized in cloud object storage - Pipeline stages matched to **measured** compute needs, with scaling options - Permissions, logging, and cost visibility **Deliverable:** a pilot deployment or blueprint, with cost/performance trade-offs.
Background: AWS S3, EC2, and Snakemake genomics pipeline with analytics across 12,500+ datasets.
AWS S3 · EC2 · Azure Data Lake Storage · Nextflow
::: ::: {.consulting-card}
03 / DATA PLATFORMS
### Life-sciences data engineering Scattered files and extracts turned into data your teams can trust. - Ingestion and transformation into **raw, curated, and analytics-ready** layers, with schema checks - **Databricks**, SQL, and Python/R notebooks where they add value - **Azure Data Factory** or AWS services for orchestration **Deliverable:** data-flow design, reusable code, and quality checks.
Background: model-ready antibody repertoires at scale; cloud data platforms covering ingestion, security, and monitoring.
Azure · AWS · Databricks · SQL · Python · R
::: ::: {.consulting-card}
04 / SCIENTIFIC AI
### Antibody and protein AI prototypes Test whether protein language models can support a research decision. - **Embeddings** (such as ESM-2) compared with transparent baselines - **Fitness and developability** scoring with held-out data and stated limitations - Reproducible notebooks or batch workflow **Deliverable:** a proof of concept, evaluation, and go/no-go recommendation. Outputs support research decisions; they do not replace experimental validation.
Background: zero-shot antibody fitness and developability pipeline, with evaluation and validation design.
Python · PyTorch · MLflow · Protein language models
::: :::
## How we start **Discovery call**, then a **focused pilot** on your data, then **build and handover**. Bring the question and your current workflow, and I will identify the smallest useful solution. [Get in touch](index.qmd#lets-connect).
